items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril under §§2.1 and 3.1.4, and §§4.3(d)–(f) independently exclude personal belongings in a vehicle away from the insured location. The payable threshold is €0; the positive figure is a placeholder.
The car is excluded under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 expressly excludes vehicle-related costs. The payable threshold is €0; the positive figure is a placeholder.
